publisher: Pennsylvania Department of Human Services / PA Open Data Portal
ownership: Publisher's monthly childcare and early-learning listing, restricted here to listed Child Care Centers and selected facility fields.
allowed_use: bounded anonymous acquisition of the selected center-only facility records
internal immutable selected-source retention, verification and later local normalization/reconciliation
prohibited_use: acquiring home-provider or other early-learning categories under this profile
requesting or retaining person, contact, phone, fax, email, legal-entity or catalog cached sample fields
interpreting license/list membership as independently verified active operations or unique businesses
public export or unrestricted redistribution under this internal profile
attribution: Pennsylvania Department of Human Services; data retrieved from data.pa.gov
retention: Preserve verified immutable acquisitions for offline reuse; preserve ordinary-failure evidence for inspection. No automatic deletion or source-current replacement.
redistribution: This implementation permits internal use only. Public field-level export requires a separately implemented review and export policy; the portal itself offers datasets free and without restriction, with applicable legal protections remaining in force.
personal_data_handling: Facility names or addresses can incidentally identify a person. Exclude home-provider categories and person/contact fields, use no people enrichment, restrict retained evidence to internal storage.
authorization_basis: Existing user instruction to acquire authorized US business data, official portal free-use notice reviewed September 8 2026, and this bounded internal facility-only scope; no click-through agreement or fee is accepted.
